rules.rows: Only Bronze rows of kind unit are read; the workbook has no other kind (profile O-1).
rules.scope: SY 2023-24 public schools only. A row of another school year or with a sector other than Public is quarantined with school_year_out_of_scope or sector_not_public, never dropped; above 1% of unit rows in quarantine fails the gate. The gate also fails if any clean row is out of scope (rows_in_scope).
rules.grain: One row per school_id and school_year, as deped_enrollment_psgc (D-049): an identical repeat keeps its first copy and quarantines the rest; differing repeats are all quarantined.
rules.identifier: A school_id that is not 6 digits is quarantined as school_id_malformed. It is kept as text, so leading zeros are never lost.
rules.codes: A code stored as 9 or 10 digits is left-padded to 10. #N/A and blank become NULL, with one psgc_null_reason for the row (source_na or not_in_workbook); any other value fails the gate. The gate also fails if the city and barangay codes are both NULL for different reasons (null_reasons_agree), so the single column never hides one.
rules.recode: Sulu's Q4 2024 codes (province 19066...) take the prefix 09066, and region 1900000000 becomes 0900000000, as in deped_enrollment_psgc (D-049).
rules.coordinates: Longitude and latitude are typed as DOUBLE; '#N/A' and blank become NULL with coordinate_flag missing. The exact text stays in Bronze only (as psa_psgc leaves its unpadded IDs there); the gate recomputes every number from its Bronze row and fails on any difference. coordinate_flag is missing, zero, outside_philippines, or NULL. No coordinate is corrected, geocoded, or inferred; distances and the boundary test (S-1) are not Silver's.
rules.not_in_silver: The 58 enrollment counts (equal to deped_enrollment for every school), the names, sector, management, annex and offering columns (restated by deped_enrollment), the PSGC names, urban/rural and income class (from psa_psgc through the code), and urp and implementing_unit (unused). All stay in Bronze; the data dictionary lists each with its reason.
